summary.text: Frank Salazar is the Republican candidate for Texas House of Representatives District 143 in the November 3, 2026 general election, facing incumbent Democrat Ana Hernandez.

paragraphs.text: Frank Salazar ran for the same seat in 2012, when he lost the May 29 Republican primary to Doug Weiskopf, 61.2 percent to 38.8 percent.
He won the March 3, 2026 Republican primary for District 143 with no opposition.
